description: Test file for CustomResourceDiscoveryController in Kubernetes API extensions server, testing CRD discovery and resource management.

classes.name: testEnvironment
classes.description: Struct encapsulating the fake client, discovery handlers, and resource manager for testing.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the discovery controller and cache synchronization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new test environment with fake client and resource manager.

methods.name: TestResourceManagerExistingCRD
methods.description: Test that existing CRDs are correctly added to the resource manager.

methods.name: TestResourceManagerAddedCRD
methods.description: Test that newly added CRDs are reflected in the resource manager.

methods.name: TestMultipleCRDSameVersion
methods.description: Test that multiple CRDs with the same version are handled correctly.

methods.name: TestDiscoveryControllerResourceManagerRemovedCRD
methods.description: Test that CRDs deletion results in removal from resource manager.
